subject: Clavicular
scope: Single front-facing source photograph; subjective cosmetic appearance assessment, not a person-invariant measurement.

report.summary: Strong brow-to-jaw vertical structure with well-balanced thirds. Curly dark hair adds volume and frames a broad forehead. Features align cleanly with moderate masculine angularity and even bilateral correspondence.

potential.label: Refined polish
potential.summary: Defined curls respond well to moisture-focused grooming for enhanced ringlet separation. Brow tidying at lateral tails would sharpen frame. Skin maintains natural clarity with minimal intervention.

categories.title: Eyes
categories.subtitle: Periocular balance and eye-line structure
categories.explanation: Hazel irises with visible limbal rings; moderate upper eyelid exposure creates alert, direct gaze. Slight lateral canthal tilt elevates outer corners subtly.
categories.recommendation: Retake under consistent lighting and a neutral expression before judging the eye area across reports.

categories.title: Nose
categories.subtitle: Bridge alignment and central facial axis
categories.explanation: Straight dorsal profile with narrow alar base. Nasal tip sits at mid-face with moderate projection, complementing overall vertical proportions.
categories.recommendation: Compare several neutral front images before deciding whether nose balance is the main limiter.

categories.title: Mouth
categories.subtitle: Lip shape, width, and lower-third fit
categories.explanation: Full vermilion with balanced upper-to-lower lip ratio. Neutral rest position shows slight lower lip eversion; cupid's bow moderately defined.
categories.recommendation: Use neutral expression consistency and simple grooming before judging mouth balance.

categories.title: Jaw
categories.subtitle: Mandible definition and chin support
categories.explanation: Broad mandibular gonial angle with clean inferior border. Moderate masseter development transitions smoothly to defined chin with slight squareness.
categories.recommendation: Keep neck posture consistent; the jaw already has enough visible structure.

categories.title: Dimorphism
categories.subtitle: Sex-typical cues weighted against harmony
categories.explanation: Dimorphism is scored from sex-typical facial cues while penalizing traits that overpower harmony or proportional balance.
categories.recommendation: Use grooming and styling first; align brows, hair, and lower-third presentation before judging contrast.

categories.title: Face shape
categories.subtitle: Frame, thirds, and silhouette continuity
categories.explanation: Oval-to-square facial outline with forehead width approximating jaw width. Vertical fifths divide evenly; hairline shows mild central widow's peak.
categories.recommendation: Improve haircut, framing, and camera posture first because those change the visible outline fastest.

categories.title: Facial definition
categories.subtitle: Cheek and lower-face clarity
categories.explanation: Mid-cheek volume present without excessive fullness. Zygomatic prominence moderate, catching light on anterior plane beneath lateral orbital rim.
categories.recommendation: Retake future scans with the same lighting, posture, and camera distance before judging soft-tissue fullness.

categories.title: Skin Age
categories.subtitle: Visible age cues
categories.explanation: Even tone with visible pore structure and scattered faint marks across cheeks and forehead. Subtle periorbital texture without discoloration.
categories.recommendation: Keep capture conditions consistent so future reports compare visible age cues fairly.

categories.title: Symmetry
categories.subtitle: Left-right balance across visible landmarks
categories.explanation: Bilateral correspondence strong across vertical midline. Minor deviation in brow peak and nostril shape visible only on close inspection.
categories.recommendation: Retake future scans straight-on before judging whether the asymmetry is persistent.

categories.title: UV context
categories.subtitle: UV context and visible tone
categories.explanation: Even tone with visible pore structure and scattered faint marks across cheeks and forehead. Subtle periorbital texture without discoloration.
categories.recommendation: Use consistent outdoor context and neutral lighting so future scans compare visible tone and texture fairly.

categories.title: Overall
categories.subtitle: Final calibrated assessment
categories.explanation: The overall score is the public report score on a 0 to 10 scale. PSL calibration remains a secondary rubric signal for comparison contexts.
categories.recommendation: Improve the lowest-scoring category first; one focused change beats scattered glow-up advice.
